name: Matthew
lede: The fortieth book of the Bible and the first of the New Testament, in full: the book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the wise-men and the star, the voice in the wilderness, the sermon on the mount, the healings and the parables of the kingdom, the transfiguration, the entry into Jerusalem, the last supper and the cross, and the empty tomb — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Son of David
books.blurb: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham: three times fourteen generations; Joseph's dream — thou shalt call his name JESUS; Immanuel, God with us; the wise-men from the east and the star that stood over the young child; gold and frankincense and myrrh; the flight into Egypt and Rachel weeping for her children; John the Baptist in the wilderness; the heavens opened and the Spirit as a dove — this is my beloved Son; forty days in the wilderness — it is written; and the fishers of men by the sea of Galilee.

books.name: The Sermon on the Mount
books.blurb: He went up into the mountain and opened his mouth and taught them: blessed are the poor in spirit; ye are the salt of the earth, ye are the light of the world; not to destroy, but to fulfil; but I say unto you — love your enemies; when thou prayest, enter into thine inner chamber: Our Father who art in heaven; treasures in heaven; consider the lilies of the field; judge not; ask, and it shall be given you; the narrow gate; by their fruits ye shall know them; and the house built upon the rock.

books.name: The Harvest Is Plenteous
books.blurb: Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean; the centurion — I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel; the foxes have holes; the tempest and the great calm — what manner of man is this?; the Gadarenes and the swine; thy sins are forgiven, arise and walk; Matthew at the place of toll; new wine into fresh wine-skins; the border of his garment and the damsel that sleepeth; the harvest indeed is plenteous, but the laborers are few; and the twelve sent forth as sheep in the midst of wolves.

books.name: Lord of the Sabbath
books.blurb: Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?; a reed shaken with the wind; we piped unto you, and ye did not dance; woe unto thee, Chorazin; come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden — my yoke is easy, and my burden is light; the grainfields on the sabbath — the Son of man is lord of the sabbath; stretch forth thy hand; a bruised reed shall he not break; a kingdom divided against itself; the sign of Jonah; and who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

books.name: The Kingdom of Heaven Is Like
books.blurb: Behold, the sower went forth to sow; the tares of the field; a grain of mustard seed; leaven hid in three measures of meal; a treasure hidden in the field and one pearl of great price; a net cast into the sea; a prophet is not without honor, save in his own country; Herod's birthday and the death of John; five loaves and two fishes, and twelve baskets full; and in the fourth watch of the night he came unto them, walking upon the sea — Lord, save me.

books.name: Thou Art the Christ
books.blurb: The tradition of the elders; if the blind guide the blind; the Canaanitish woman — even the dogs eat of the crumbs; seven loaves and seven baskets full; the signs of the times; the leaven of the Pharisees; at Cæsarea Philippi — but who say ye that I am? Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God; get thee behind me; take up his cross; the high mountain, Moses and Elijah, and a voice out of the bright cloud — hear ye him; faith as a grain of mustard seed; and the shekel in the fish's mouth.
